gates.name: exact_typed_operands
gates.evidence: Closed schemas and tenant/profile/generation bindings deny missing, unknown, stale, duplicate, conflicting and out-of-scope inputs.

gates.name: canonical_intersection
gates.evidence: The least-permissive action/resource/field/purpose/effect intersection returns ALLOW, ESCALATE or DENY with four contributing ceilings, ordered reason facts and a stable digest.

gates.name: permission_xray_parity
gates.evidence: The GET-only view renders the exact machine outcome, scope, ceilings, reasons, issues and source result digest; omission or weakening fails parity.

gates.name: adversarial_regression_evidence
gates.evidence: Capability-only, empty intersection, schema-extra, binding, generation, unknown-scope and view-tamper probes deny without authority; focused, full and live-smoke evidence passed.

nonClaims: No production IAM, role-source freshness, tenant isolation or authorization completeness.
No executable authority, credential, lease or provider effect is issued by the compiler or X-ray.
No push, pull request, merge, tag, release, publication or production deployment.
